ns2:section.sectionText: Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This online course begins August 27th and ends December 10th. The course includes three face-to-face (site-based) meetings that will be held at the University of Illinois, College of Medicine in Peoria, IL (One Illini Drive). The dates, times, and room assignment for the face-to-face meetings have not yet been determined. Instructor: Chris Larrison; email: larrison@uiuc.edu
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $372.00 per Bill Hour, and Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Fees $41.00 per Bill Hour.
